description: Remove an entry from the succession plan outright (a queued future planting that hasn't been sown). This is a hard delete, not recoverable — for a planting already sown/growing, use delete_planting instead. Identify it by id (from list_planned_plantings).

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

name: delete_planned_planting
title: Delete a planned planting
